sarf.front: In a <bdi>رُبَاعِيّ</bdi> verb, what is the fourth root letter counted as?
sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: thulāthī mazīd fīh — class notes 2026-10-23

sarf.meaning: the added letters in the <bdi>هُوَ</bdi> form of a <bdi>مَزِيد فِيه</bdi> verb
sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: thulāthī mazīd fīh — class notes 2026-10-23

sarf.front: What is each <bdi>بَاب</bdi> of the <bdi>مَزِيد فِيه</bdi> named after?
sarf.back: Its <bdi>مَصْدَر</bdi>, put on the letters fāʾ, ʿayn, lām — as in <bdi>تَفْعِيل</bdi> and <bdi>مُفَاعَلَة</bdi>
sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: thulāthī mazīd fīh — class notes 2026-10-23

sarf.front: Besides the <bdi>مَصْدَر</bdi> it's named after, how is each <bdi>بَاب</bdi> of the <bdi>مَزِيد فِيه</bdi> labelled?
sarf.back: With a Roman numeral: <bdi>تَفْعِيل</bdi> is II, and <bdi>مُفَاعَلَة</bdi> is III
sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: thulāthī mazīd fīh — class notes 2026-10-23

sarf.front: What do many <bdi>مَزِيد فِيه</bdi> abwāb lack in the <bdi>أَمْر</bdi>, unlike family one?
sarf.back: A <bdi>هَمْزَة الوَصْل</bdi>: the <bdi>أَمْر</bdi> of <bdi>تَفْعِيل</bdi> is <bdi>فَعِّلْ</bdi>, and the <bdi>أَمْر</bdi> of <bdi>مُفَاعَلَة</bdi> is <bdi>فَاعِلْ</bdi>
sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: thulāthī mazīd fīh — class notes 2026-10-23

sarf.front: How are the <bdi>اِسْم الفَاعِل</bdi> and the <bdi>اِسْم المَفْعُول</bdi> of a <bdi>مَزِيد فِيه</bdi> verb formed?
sarf.back: Change the <bdi>حَرْف المُضَارِع</bdi> to a mīm with a ḍammah. The letter before the last then takes a kasrah in the <bdi>اِسْم الفَاعِل</bdi> (<bdi>مُفَعِّلٌ</bdi>) and a fatḥah in the <bdi>اِسْم المَفْعُول</bdi> (<bdi>مُفَعَّلٌ</bdi>).
sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: thulāthī mazīd fīh — class notes 2026-10-23
